image_description: A black and white close-up photograph of a disposable plastic lighter resting diagonally on top of a cigarette pack. The lighter features bold, capitalized text reading 'BUY YOUR OWN FUCKING LIGHTER'. The flame guard and spark wheel mechanism are visible at the top left. The background shows part of the cigarette pack with circular design elements.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object's proportions relative to the cigarette pack confirm it is a standard handheld size.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is rectangular with rounded corners, typical of disposable lighters, with a fixed top assembly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The metal wind guard and nozzle structure are clearly visible at the top left end of the device.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The serrated spark wheel is visible next to the nozzle assembly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nozzle tip is present within the wind guard; while not lit, the structural component is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The device has a fixed top configuration with an integrated spark wheel, consistent with disposable lighter designs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The casing appears to be smooth plastic with printed text, consistent with standard disposable lighter materials.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The reservoir is internal and opaque; its presence cannot be visually verified without X-ray or transparency.
The object is clearly designed for portability and ignition.

artifact_observations.location: Text on the side of the cigarette pack in the background (right side).
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical text on the cigarette pack is partially illegible and distorted ('TTES'), which is a common minor artifact in AI-generated images involving background text, though it could also be due to depth-of-field blur.

artifact_observations.location: Plastic wrap reflection on the cigarette pack.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The specular highlights on the plastic wrapping appear slightly smeared and lack the crisp micro-reflections expected in a high-resolution macro shot, suggesting slight generative smoothing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of lighter (disposable vs. Zippo-style) and ensure it matches the 'lighter' class label accurately.
To verify the legibility and correctness of the prominent text 'BUY YOUR OWN FUCKING LIGHTER', as AI often fails with long, specific phrases.
To check for edge bleeding between the lighter and the cigarette pack, ensuring the objects are distinct and physically separate.
To assess the realism of the black and white grain, lighting consistency, and depth of field effects.

focus_areas: Text legibility and font consistency on the lighter body.
Structural integrity of the spark wheel and nozzle assembly.
Boundary sharpness between the lighter and the background cigarette pack.
Realism of plastic textures and specular highlights.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text rendering. AI models frequently distort specific profanity or long slogans. Verify if the font perspective matches the cylinder curvature of the lighter. Check if the spark wheel has realistic serrations or if it looks like a melted blob.
